entries.question: I want to book opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   **Website:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh as the state and KGMU as the hospital. Choose your department, date, and time slot, then pay the ₹50 fee online.
*   **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**2. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**3. Walk-in Registration**
*   You can visit the hospital in person. **Please note:** You must carry your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
*   Registration counters are open Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM).
*   **Fee:** ₹50 (flat rate).

**Important Information:**
*   **Pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.
*   If you are an outside-city patient, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is an emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Sir mujhe DOTT me addmission lena hai addmission kaise hoga
entries.answer:
DOTT (Diploma in Operation Theatre Technology) mein admission ke liye aapko KGMU ki official website **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)** par bane **"Courses & Admission"** section ko regular check karna hoga.

Admission se sambandhit mahatvapurn jaankari ke liye aap ye steps follow kar sakte hain:

1. **Website check karein:** [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par jaakar current admission notifications aur prospectus dekhein.
2. **Eligibility aur Process:** Admission aamtaur par entrance exam ya merit-based hota hai, jo university dwara jari ki gayi guidelines par nirbhar karta hai.
3. **Important Notice Board:** Naye notices ke liye [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) dekhte rahein taaki koi form miss na ho.

Agar aapko admission form ya eligibility criteria ke baare mein koi specific jaankari chahiye, toh aap Registrar Office se bhi sampark kar sakte hain (Phone: 0522-2253171).
